description: The file defines the GameController class, which manages the game state, handles user input, updates game logic, and communicates with external services for a word-guessing game (similar to Wordle). It orchestrates game lifecycle events such as initializing game assets, starting new games, processing guesses, and updating statistics. It also exposes reactive properties for UI updates via ChangeNotifier.

classes.name: GameController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the game state, user interactions, and communication with repositories and services for the word guessing game. Extends ChangeNotifier to enable reactive UI updates.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads target words, valid words, user stats, and starts a daily game, setting the assets as ready.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Begins a new game session, optionally as a daily, deterministic game.

methods.name: inputLetter
methods.description: Adds a letter to the current input if game is not complete and input length permits.

methods.name: deleteLetter
methods.description: Removes the last letter from the current input if any.

methods.name: submitGuess
methods.description: Validates and evaluates the current guess, updates game state, keyboard state, checks for win/loss, and updates stats accordingly.

methods.name: _showBanner
methods.description: Sets a feedback message to inform the player of input errors or game states.

methods.name: _updateStatsOnGameEnd
methods.description: Updates user statistics upon game completion (win/loss) and persists data asynchronously.

methods.name: exportGameState
methods.description: Serializes the current game state to JSON for persistence.
